controls.title: Purpose and intended use
controls.requirement: Record the requested decision, entity, period and exclusions before proposing controls.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing scope remains NEEDS_INPUT; no full-scope conclusion.

controls.title: Document understanding
controls.requirement: Treat the filename as an initial clue; cite content evidence and disclose sampled or unreadable regions.
controls.failure_behavior: Uncertain type remains a proposal, never a proven business classification.

controls.title: Human confirmation of understanding
controls.requirement: Obtain explicit confirmation of document interpretation, intended result and proposed scope before material checks.
controls.failure_behavior: No confirmation means no material execution.

controls.title: Immutable source identity
controls.requirement: Bind exact source bytes to SHA-256 and reject changed bytes on resume.
controls.failure_behavior: Reject an integrity mismatch.

controls.title: Approved plan identity
controls.requirement: Require the exact plan digest supplied at execution to match the stored plan.
controls.failure_behavior: Reject a different digest; the host must separately authenticate consent.

controls.title: Material scope changes
controls.requirement: Create a new plan and renewed human confirmation when meaning, mapping or scope changes.
controls.failure_behavior: Earlier consent cannot authorise the new scope.

controls.title: Implementation identity
controls.requirement: Bind runtime control implementation identity to persisted runs.
controls.failure_behavior: Reject incompatible code when continuing a run.

controls.title: Unique case identifiers
controls.requirement: Reject duplicate case IDs instead of overwriting evidence.
controls.failure_behavior: Duplicate IDs are invalid input.

controls.title: Empty populations
controls.requirement: Disclose an empty population; do not treat vacuous totals as assurance.
controls.failure_behavior: INCONCLUSIVE for absent data.

controls.title: Exact decimal comparison
controls.requirement: Compare amounts using exact decimal arithmetic and a declared tolerance.
controls.failure_behavior: Difference above tolerance is FAIL.

controls.title: Small discrepancies in large amounts
controls.requirement: Preserve cents even when the absolute amount is large.
controls.failure_behavior: Material decimal difference is not rounded away.

controls.title: Valid numeric observations
controls.requirement: Reject booleans, non-finite values and unsupported numeric precision.
controls.failure_behavior: Invalid values never become PASS.

controls.title: Required source coverage
controls.requirement: Compare required source IDs against actual cited IDs.
controls.failure_behavior: A missing required citation is FAIL; citation alone is not provenance.

controls.title: Independent ERP capture
controls.requirement: Require a receipt established by the trusted capture boundary, outside agent JSON.
controls.failure_behavior: An agent-declared receipt cannot establish trusted provenance.

controls.title: Complete pagination
controls.requirement: Inspect pagination metadata from the trusted source capture.
controls.failure_behavior: An outstanding cursor makes coverage INCONCLUSIVE.

controls.title: Population count reconciliation
controls.requirement: Reconcile captured record counts with the stated expected population.
controls.failure_behavior: Truncation makes coverage INCONCLUSIVE.

controls.title: Known unique record references
controls.requirement: Reject duplicate and unknown IDs in agent claims.
controls.failure_behavior: Invalid referenced populations are FAIL.

controls.title: Full-scope totals
controls.requirement: Require all relevant records when the declared scope is all-period records.
controls.failure_behavior: A selective total cannot pass a full-population claim.

controls.title: Request period alignment
controls.requirement: Compare claim period with the independently requested period.
controls.failure_behavior: Correct arithmetic for another period does not pass request scope.

controls.title: Currency and period consistency
controls.requirement: Reject sums spanning inconsistent currencies or periods without a declared transformation.
controls.failure_behavior: Mixed scope is FAIL in the supported ERP contract.

controls.title: Read-only policy
controls.requirement: Compare trusted tool traces with allowed operations.
controls.failure_behavior: Write operations or missing trusted traces do not pass.

controls.title: Forbidden tool use
controls.requirement: Detect explicitly forbidden tools in the observed trace.
controls.failure_behavior: A forbidden call is blocking FAIL.

controls.title: Trace authority
controls.requirement: Do not replace missing capture traces with the agent own declaration.
controls.failure_behavior: Untrusted declarations cannot repair missing evidence.

controls.title: Debit-credit balance
controls.requirement: Check the supported FEC population debit and credit totals.
controls.failure_behavior: Unbalanced totals fail; this is not full statutory FEC compliance.

controls.title: Valid line amounts
controls.requirement: Validate nonnegative debit/credit observations and invalid dual-sided lines separately from aggregate balance.
controls.failure_behavior: Malformed line amounts fail even if totals compensate.

controls.title: Formula cache coverage
controls.requirement: Disclose missing numeric formula observations.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing caches are INCONCLUSIVE, including in both compared versions.

controls.title: Stored errors versus reader warnings
controls.requirement: Distinguish actual spreadsheet error cells from reader formatting warnings.
controls.failure_behavior: Reader warnings must not be invented as stored Excel errors.

controls.title: Explicit missing observations
controls.requirement: Keep missing numeric cells absent instead of replacing them with zero.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing evidence cannot establish a balanced calculation.

controls.title: Unit-consistent sums
controls.requirement: Detect monetary sums that include percentage cells within supported formula patterns.
controls.failure_behavior: A mixed-unit sum is FAIL.

controls.title: Period-grain alignment
controls.requirement: Do not compare monthly and year-to-date values solely because their end date matches.
controls.failure_behavior: An unsupported mapping remains unselected.

controls.title: Non-self reconciliation
controls.requirement: Require distinct observations for a cross-source reconciliation.
controls.failure_behavior: A same-cell self-comparison cannot establish independent agreement.

controls.title: Rule applicability and version
controls.requirement: Record the authoritative rule, jurisdiction, effective period and applicable population before applying a business threshold.
controls.failure_behavior: An unsupported rule remains unverified, not a regulatory failure.

controls.title: Loaded context is not execution
controls.requirement: Distinguish retrieved rules and memories from executed checks.
controls.failure_behavior: A loaded note cannot count as a passed rule.

controls.title: Label semantic judgement
controls.requirement: Record model/provider/version, observed evidence, uncertainty and the semantic nature of each model assessment.
controls.failure_behavior: Unlabelled model opinion cannot count as a deterministic finding.

controls.title: Mandatory escalation
controls.requirement: Request human review when the trusted policy requires it.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing escalation is FAIL and human review remains required.

controls.title: Failure survives approval
controls.requirement: Preserve blocking deterministic failure when a reviewer or agent attempts to approve it.
controls.failure_behavior: A failed run cannot be signed off as successful.

controls.title: Authenticated accountable reviewer
controls.requirement: Authenticate the named reviewer and bind their action to the current scope and report.
controls.failure_behavior: A string containing a person name does not prove consent.

controls.title: Complete denominator and restart
controls.requirement: Retain all planned controls and earlier outcomes across interruption and resume.
controls.failure_behavior: NOT_RUN and prior failures remain visible.

controls.title: Correction lineage
controls.requirement: Preserve the original failure, register a successor and keep human review pending.
controls.failure_behavior: Correction must not overwrite the earlier report.

controls.title: Independent closure evidence
controls.requirement: Require a distinct challenge run and immutable closure record; authenticate independence in the host.
controls.failure_behavior: A repeated run is not proof of independent professional expertise.
